sermon.title: Clapping Hands and Shouting
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer teaches from Psalm 47 that we are to clap and shout to God, who places the nations beneath his people—not by force but through feet shod with the gospel of peace and through obedience to his voice. Love is the more excellent way, and believers grow into the divine nature. God avenges and delivers the righteous, as in a deliverance he witnessed, and all who call on Jesus are saved.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Points to check: Psalm 47:1 spoken as “47 verse 10”; Romans 10:15 spoken as “holmen 1015”; the claim that “subdue” in Psalm 47:3 is rendered “speak” elsewhere hundreds of times; nations unknown until the 15th–16th century. Sensitive content kept as spoken: Muslims conquer by force (“off with your head”); communist governments; Democratic Party “invaded by the liberal progressive community… set out to make America a socialist nation” and destroy the Constitution; welfare without work; abortion and same-sex movement; deliverance account; Mexican Mafia member who murdered and enslaved girls; “unconditional love is a lie”.

faqs.question: What does Psalm 47:1 command?
faqs.answer: Clap your hands and shout to God with triumph.

faqs.question: What does he say subdue means in Psalm 47:3?
Why must believers prepare?
faqs.answer: He can’t send you if you’re not prepared.

faqs.question: Why hadn’t he prophesied in months?
faqs.answer: The Spirit wasn’t saying anything; they weren’t hungry.

faqs.question: May Christians use arms to spread the gospel?
faqs.answer: No, only to defend nation and family.

faqs.question: What is the more excellent way?
Is welfare without work scriptural?
faqs.answer: He says it is totally unscriptural.

faqs.question: Is a ritual needed to cast out demons?
Must you do anything to be saved?
faqs.answer: Yes, call on Jesus and turn.
